articles.summary: A full trading day of US equities, 354 million top-of-book events, streamed back from QuestDB as Arrow. In strict time order the client peaks at 194 MiB; parallel connections reach 14 Gb/s, using more memory as more results arrive at once. Code, commands and hardware included so you can rerun it.
articles.title: Market data replay for backtesting: a full day of US equities from QuestDB

articles.summary: We gave AI coding agents a trading desk with planted problems, the QuestDB skill and MCP server, and one question: is anyone picking us off? Markouts, adverse selection and transaction cost analysis, scored against the answer key, with every finding reproducible in SQL.
articles.title: Agentic trade execution analysis: markouts, TCA and what agents find

articles.summary: We ran the workloads from an AWS Flink vs Spark Real-time Mode benchmark on a single QuestDB server, with and without Kafka, and no stream processor.
articles.title: Do you need Spark or Flink for that? Streaming on QuestDB

articles.title: Measuring port congestion from free AIS data with NATS and QuestDB

articles.title: QuestDB 10.2: improved power-loss durability mode

articles.title: QuestDB Enterprise 4.2.1: improved power-loss durability, ACL audit log
